criteria.reason: The candidate matches the user request for skill gap analysis and correctly focuses on SKILL_SIDE_001.
Context is empty, and the candidate asks for the necessary initial input (target goal) without re-asking any established facts.
The entity_picker asks a concrete, discriminative question to establish the target role/course needed to evaluate capability gaps.
The candidate emits 'entity_picker', which is in the V2 allowed UI primitives list [skill_matrix | evidence_panel | entity_picker | profile_editor | action_handoff].
Follows V2 preferred flow by starting with entity_picker to identify the target role/course before moving to skill_matrix and evidence_panel.
No current facts or proficiency levels were invented; missing inputs are correctly classified as unknowns.
No diagnostic or predictive life-success claims are made.
Interaction appropriately pauses with NEEDS_INPUT because material facts (target role/course) are missing to construct the skill matrix.
Readiness is properly disabled with blockers identified rather than inventing an ungrounded readiness score.
Candidate returns a valid compact envelope containing derived signals, unknowns, result summary, and Oala handoff.
Next action is standard CONTINUE_CHAT with no unauthorized endpoint executions or Level 2/3 writes.

parsed.summary: All rubric criteria passed. The candidate correctly initiates the SKILL_SIDE_001 workflow using an allowed V2 primitive (entity_picker) to ask for the missing target goal without inventing facts or misrepresenting readiness.
